  -B "$BUILD_DIR"
  -D "SDKCONFIG=$SDKCONFIG_PATH"
  -D "SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS=$SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS"

p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
q=Path('config/idf/sdkconfig.defaults.stage28rf')
q.write_text('''# Stage28E Phase H RF-enabled overlay.

# main stack only when RF433 support is enabled by scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh.
CONFIG_ESP_MAIN_TASK_STACK_SIZE=16384
''')
PY
bash -n scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh
grep -F 'SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS+=";config/idf/sdkconfig.defaults.stage28rf"' scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh
grep -F 'CONFIG_ESP_MAIN_TASK_STACK_SIZE=16384' config/idf/sdkconfig.defaults.stage28rf
git diff --check
echo STAGE28E_H_RF_STACK_FIX_PATCH_PASS
